budget_basis: The frame, hitch, and memory ceilings are inherited from the world-transvoxel production full-world Godot soak. Two complete Windows debug calibration runs observed settlement p95 values of 2166763 and 3095576 usec; 4000000 usec is the bounded regression ceiling. Update, persistence, and throughput limits are reference ceilings, not production frame-time targets.
qualified_scope: native world-transvoxel procedural terrain streaming over a roughly two-kilometre reference span
continuous traversal and distant teleport settlement
native edit publication and authoritative query agreement during the soak
stale viewer and stale edit rejection while the world remains usable
durable edit-journal restart and post-restart authoritative query agreement
fail-closed negative control for unsupported large-volume snapshot compaction
bounded Windows debug frame, throughput, memory, queue, resource, and shutdown regression ceilings
explicitly_unqualified_scope: GPU meshing, GPU residency, or driver performance
large-volume snapshot compaction beyond the current native page and byte capacities
production navigation, gameplay, networking, or integration-game suitability
